title: Gateway TOFU store has no peer bound or admission backpressure
description: Security review P2. TrustStore::verify_tofu inserts every new valid key-derived IID into an unbounded std HashMap. An untrusted discovery source can cheaply generate unlimited key/IID pairs and grow memory indefinitely; there is no MAX_PEERS, eviction policy safe for live pins, admission rate limit, or explicit full error. Bound the trust store, require deliberate admission/backpressure at capacity, never evict active pins on attacker input, and add capacity/flood tests.
